notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.3.7

Improved
- Christmas look: the taskbar icon has a little snow on it too.
- Updates: clearer messages while an update downloads or waits for E-Sys to close, and Cancel always stays on screen.
- Order codes and faults: names and fault meanings also show when the names arrive a little later; the inch sign shows right in wheel names.
- Copy: copying a report says so when Windows did not allow it.
- Write to us: choosing "move my licence" opens the move form straight away.
- Service reset: the reset question also warns when the car's date looks wrong.
- Dates read the same on every Windows language and calendar.
- Invite a friend: the card fits better and updates when your licence changes.
- Problem reports and local files are handled more safely.
- Many small fixes.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
